strategy_roster.name: Stochastic Overbought/Oversold Reversal
strategy_roster.notes: Stochastic proxy: RSI oversold (<30) to neutral (50). Simple mean reversion. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Three White Soldiers
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and close > donchian_high_prev(high,1) and close > sma(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: Three consecutive bullish candles with higher closes, above MA(20). Long momentum continuation. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Three Black Crows
strategy_roster.entry_long: close < open and close < donchian_low_prev(low,1) and close < sma(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: Three consecutive bearish candles with lower closes, below MA(20). Short momentum (approximated as long exit). StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Rejection Candle
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and (high - close) <= 0.1 * (high - low) and close > sma(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: Rejection candle: small upper shadow (<=10% of range), bullish close above MA(20). StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Day of Week Effect
strategy_roster.notes: Day of week proxy: long when price above MA(20) with bullish close (seasonality not representable in daily data). StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Bollinger Stochastic
strategy_roster.notes: Bollinger + Stochastic: close below lower BB with RSI oversold. Exit mid band or RSI > 50. No fixed stop documented.

strategy_roster.name: Rsi Williams R
strategy_roster.notes: RSI + Williams %R proxy: RSI oversold and close >2 ATR below MA(20). Long mean reversion. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: Cointegration Pairs
strategy_roster.notes: Cointegration proxy: price deviates >2 std below MA(20). Mean reversion to MA. StopLoss=2% documented.

strategy_roster.name: CCI Mean Reversion
strategy_roster.notes: CCI mean reversion proxy: close >2 std below MA(20) with oversold RSI. No fixed stop documented.

strategy_roster.name: Bollinger Width Mean Reversion
strategy_roster.entry_long: bb_upper(close,20,2) - bb_lower(close,20,2) < 0.5 * sma(bb_upper(close,20,2) - bb_lower(close,20,2), 20) and close > sma(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: Bollinger width contraction (<50% of 20-bar avg) with price above MA(20). Long on squeeze breakout. No fixed stop documented.
